source_cn:
“伟大母亲”，现已确认为▇▇▇▇的化身，繁衍与生育的象征，掌握生命孕育与血肉繁衍，占据▇▇▇▇权柄。信仰祂的组织包括▇▇母亲、玫瑰学派、原始月亮。
向祂祈求会获得旺盛的繁衍能力，但会逐渐丧失理智，性情狂热，探求生命与灵性本质的禁忌，陷入对生育与繁衍的欲望……
献祭的密契仪式需要大量的血肉与生命，过程伴随着极致的疯狂和混乱……
廷根危机中，月亮仆从以献祭整座城市为代价，制造邪神子嗣降临的容器，带来毁灭性的灾难……
ref_en:
"Great Mother", now confirmed to be an avatar of ▇▇▇▇, the symbol of reproduction and fertility, mastering the conception of life and the proliferation of flesh and blood, occupying the ▇▇▇▇ authority. Organizations that believe in Her include the ▇▇ Mother, the Rose School of Thought, and the Primordial Moon.
Praying to Her will grant vigorous reproductive ability, but one will gradually lose their sanity, become fanatical, seek the taboos of life and the essence of spirituality, and fall into the desire for birth and reproduction...
The secret ritual of sacrifice requires a large amount of flesh, blood, and life, and the process is accompanied by extreme madness and chaos...
During the Tingen crisis, the Moon Servant sacrificed the entire city as the price to create a vessel for the descent of the evil god's offspring, bringing about a devastating catastrophe...
...Let me think about it some more.

source_cn:
很久很久以前，丰饶之树还只是一粒小小的种子。

它沉眠于大地母神教会中，由圣者精心保管。圣者知晓它身负生机与荒芜两种强大的力量，不能被轻易种下。

直到那场背弃誓言的战争降临。大地化为焦土，生机纷纷湮灭，圣者站在同伴和敌人的尸体间，落下了一滴泪。 

至少，要让这片大地重生。 

种子进入泥土后迅速生长，生机怦然降临之时，荒芜也伸出爪牙——于是圣者挺身而出，将无尽的荒芜统统纳入身躯。

变动终于平息，丰饶之树睁开了眼睛。

她化为人形的灵体，懵懂如婴孩，裹着一袭金色的披风。 

一个遥远的声音在她心头回荡： 

这是大地的礼物。

这是丰饶的呼唤。
ref_en:
Once upon a time, the Tree of Abundance was just a tiny seed.

It slumbered in the Church of the Earth Mother, carefully guarded by a Saint. The Saint knew that it carried two powerful forces, vitality and desolation, and could not be planted easily.

Until the war that betrayed the oath arrived. The earth turned into scorched earth, vitality was annihilated one after another, and the Saint stood among the corpses of companions and enemies, shedding a tear.

At the very least, let this land be reborn.

After the seed entered the soil, it grew rapidly. When vitality arrived with a bang, desolation also stretched out its claws—so the Saint stepped forward, taking all the endless desolation into their own body.

The change finally subsided, and the Tree of Abundance opened its eyes.

She turned into a human-shaped spirit, ignorant as an infant, wrapped in a golden cloak.

A distant voice echoed in her heart:

This is the gift of the earth.

This is the call of abundance.

source_cn:
<Assistant_Title1>城堡</>
<Assistant_Title2>玩法说明：</>
玩家自行建造<Assistant_Property2>城堡</>，可在城堡内进行<Assistant_Property1>建造</>、<Assistant_Property1>工坊生产</>、<Assistant_Property1>市场收购</>、<Assistant_Property1>铁路大亨</>等玩法。
<Assistant_Title2>获得方式：</>
扮演等级>19级的非凡者，通过完成奇迹的城堡任务解锁城堡，点击<Assistant_System>菜单-城堡</>可回到城堡。
<Assistant_Title2>城堡升级条件：</>
1. 当前城堡可升级（城堡最高等级随服务器开服天数逐步开放）。
2. <Assistant_Property2>城堡总评分</>（城堡组件评分总和）达到指定评分。 
3. <Assistant_Property2>城堡建造评分</>（城堡实际摆放的组件评分总和）达到指定评分。
4. 以上条件达成后，再消耗一定<Assistant_Property2>城堡资产</>即可升级。 
<Assistant_Title2>城堡资产作用：</>
<Assistant_Property2>城堡资材</>可用于购买家具和城堡升级消耗。
<Assistant_Title2>城堡资产获得：</>
1. 任务奖励——完成<Assistant_Property1>铁路大亨</>任务可获得城堡资产。
2. 市场收购——非凡者可以通过将城堡工坊产出的物产，去他人城堡卖出获得城堡资产。
<Assistant_Title2>城堡资产存储：</>
1. 城堡可获得资产有每周上限，超过可获得上限的资产将无法累计；同理，超过城堡存储资产上限也将无法累计。
2. 每周可获得资产、城堡资产存储上限将随城堡等级一并提升。
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>Castle</>
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Instructions: </>
Players can build their own <Assistant_Property2>Castle</>, where they can engage in <Assistant_Property1>Construction</>, <Assistant_Property1>Workshop Production</>, <Assistant_Property1>Market Acquisition</>, <Assistant_Property1>Railway Tycoon</>, and other gameplay.
<Assistant_Title2>How to Obtain: </>
Beyonders with an Acting Level > 19 can unlock the castle by completing the Miracle Castle quest. Click <Assistant_System>Menu-Castle</> to return to the castle.
<Assistant_Title2>Castle Upgrade Conditions: </>
1. The current castle can be upgraded (the maximum castle level gradually opens based on the number of days the server has been live).
2. <Assistant_Property2>Total Castle Rating</> (sum of castle component ratings) reaches the specified rating. 
3. <Assistant_Property2>Castle Construction Rating</> (sum of ratings of components actually placed in the castle) reaches the specified rating.
4. After meeting the above conditions, consume a certain amount of <Assistant_Property2>Castle Assets</> to upgrade. 
<Assistant_Title2>Purpose of Castle Assets: </>
<Assistant_Property2>Castle Assets</> can be used to purchase furniture and for castle upgrade costs.
<Assistant_Title2>How to Obtain Castle Assets: </>
1. Quest Rewards—Complete <Assistant_Property1>Railway Tycoon</> quests to obtain Castle Assets.
2. Market Acquisition—Beyonders can sell products produced by their castle workshop at other players' castles to obtain Castle Assets.
<Assistant_Title2>Castle Asset Storage: </>
1. There is a weekly cap on the assets a castle can obtain; assets exceeding the cap cannot be accumulated. Similarly, assets exceeding the castle's storage limit cannot be accumulated.
2. The weekly obtainable assets and the castle asset storage limit will increase along with the castle level.

source_cn: 当前认知经验获取效率：%d%% 认知经验获取</> 足够的认知有利于扮演的推进。完成主线、支线、时代与漫游任务，以及参与各类日常玩法（包括<Yellow>轻松躺赢、以战养战、世界冒险</>等），均可获得大量认知经验。当你重历“愚者”先生的历史时，受“嫁接”的力量影响，同样可以获取属于自己的那份认知经验。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>等级限制规则</> 当扮演等级提升至最终上限后，继续积累的认知经验将用于开启神性等级——超越限度的认知，人性将越来越淡薄，离神越来越近。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>扮演中的人性与神性</> “万物皆有神性，当扮演超出限度，你将逐步走向最初的神性。” 非凡者通过日常的体验、任务与探索，不断接受关于这个世界的认知，并将其转化为<Yellow>认知经验</>。积累认知经验，可逐步提升自我的<Yellow>扮演等级</>，通过扮演以巩固精神与存在的稳定性。 然而，认知与扮演本身蕴含风险，扮演的每一步也在支付着代价。当扮演等级提升至最终上限后，人性将无法维持扮演带来的影响——后续的扮演将开始塑造神性。非凡者将在扮演中逐步走向神性，从而提升<Yellow>神性等级</>。 为防止短时间内接收过量认知导致精神崩溃，您被“愚者”先生赋予了限制等级的保护性祝福。在当前的扮演等级或神性等级下，身体与精神必须经历足够的适应与沉淀，方能突破等级限制，承受更高层次的认知，迈向下一阶段。
ref_en: Current Cognitive Experience acquisition efficiency: %d%% Cognitive Experience Acquisition</> Sufficient cognition is beneficial for the advancement of Acting. Completing main quests, side quests, Era and Roaming quests, and participating in various daily activities (including <Yellow>Easy Wins, War-Driven Growth, World Adventure</>, etc.) will grant a large amount of Cognitive Experience. When you relive the history of Mr. Fool, influenced by the power of "Grafting," you can also obtain your own share of Cognitive Experience. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>Level Limit Rules</> After the Acting Level reaches the final cap, accumulated Cognitive Experience will be used to unlock Divinity Level—cognition beyond the limit makes humanity increasingly faint, bringing you closer to God. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>Humanity and Divinity in Acting</> "All things have divinity; when Acting exceeds the limit, you will gradually move toward the original divinity." Beyonders continuously accept cognition about this world through daily experiences, quests, and exploration, converting it into <Yellow>Cognitive Experience</>. Accumulating Cognitive Experience can gradually improve your <Yellow>Acting Level</>, consolidating the stability of your spirit and existence through Acting. However, cognition and Acting themselves contain risks, and every step of Acting comes with a price. When the Acting Level reaches the final cap, humanity will be unable to maintain the influence brought by Acting—subsequent Acting will begin to shape divinity. Beyonders will gradually move toward divinity during Acting, thereby increasing their <Yellow>Divinity Level</>. To prevent mental collapse from receiving excessive cognition in a short period, you have been granted a protective blessing by Mr. Fool that limits your level. At the current Acting Level or Divinity Level, your body and spirit must undergo sufficient adaptation and precipitation before you can break through the level limit, withstand higher levels of cognition, and move to the next stage.

ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Exploration】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Instructions:</>In the world of Lord of Mysteries, you can explore the 【Order World】 in various maps, as well as the 【City Dark Side】 gameplay in Tingen. Participating in the gameplay increases the completion of the Order World and the bounty value of the City Dark Side, allowing you to claim generous progress rewards.
<Assistant_Title2>Entrance Guide:</>
1. TRPG Entrance
Open the menu to enter 【TRPG】, join any sect, and then enter the 【Order World】 or 【City Dark Side】. Select the corresponding gameplay or event and click 【Go】 to automatically pathfind.
2. Map Entrance
Open the map in the top right corner, switch to the 【Exploration】 tab, and select to enter the 【Order World】 or 【City Dark Side】. Then select the gameplay or event you want to experience and click 【Go】 to automatically pathfind.

<Assistant_Title2>Exploration Tips:</>
{SendAnswer:1.Leap of Spirituality|882}: During exploration, you can long-press the jump button to enter the spirituality leap state; click the jump button again to leap higher!
{SendAnswer:2.spirit vision|883}: Click the spirit vision button to enter the spirit vision state, where you can discover nearby treasure chests, quest clues, and interactive puzzle points.

<Assistant_Title2>名词介绍：</>加入<Assistant_System>安魂诗社</>的玩家可对其他玩家使用的特殊治疗行为，用于回复目标玩家的理智值。

<Assistant_Title2>成功率机制：</>安魂的<Assistant_System>治疗成功率</>由两项因素共同决定——安魂者所在<Assistant_System>社团的等级</>，以及被安魂者当前的<Assistant_System>理智值高低</>。社团等级越高、对方理智值越高，安魂成功的概率也越高。

<Assistant_Title2>失败风险：</>安魂并非没有风险——<Assistant_System>若安魂失败</>，参与双方的理智值均有概率受到波动，产生一定损耗。
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Sanity】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Term Introduction: </>A special healing action that players who have joined the <Assistant_System>Requiem Poetry Society </> can use on other players to restore the target player's Sanity. 

<Assistant_Title2>Trigger Condition: </>The target player's Sanity must be <Assistant_System>below a certain value </> before a Requiem can be initiated. 

<Assistant_Title2>Success Rate Mechanism: </>The <Assistant_System>healing success rate </> of a Requiem is determined by two factors: the level of the <Assistant_System>Society </> the Requiem performer belongs to, and the current <Assistant_System>Sanity </> level of the person receiving the Requiem. The higher the Society level and the higher the target's Sanity, the higher the probability of a successful Requiem. 

<Assistant_Title2>Failure Risk: </>A Requiem is not without risk—<Assistant_System>if the Requiem fails, </> both participants have a chance to experience Sanity fluctuations, resulting in a certain amount of loss.

source_cn:
找寻预言之物，窥见真相，逃离噩梦——
<P_Yellow>一物藏匿，羔羊归家之音不再奏响。</>
<P_Yellow>一物收存，新生之种，葬于石像之侧。</>
<P_Yellow>一物隐蔽，绯红月辉照耀其上。</>
……
……
新生者，再次新生。
十九次，{{他|她}}已在梦中死亡十九次。
这一次，是{{他|她}}的第二十次噩梦。
{{他|她}}翻开本不该出现在此的，安提哥努斯笔记。
然后，死于笔记的力量导致的失控。
新生者，再次新生。
这一次，是{{他|她}}的第二十一次噩梦。
……
新生者再次见到安提哥努斯笔记。
{{他|她}}没有翻开笔记，而是抽走一张⬛⬛牌。
……
新生者来到插满鲜花的祭坛前，决定做点什么。
新生者的内心，萌生出弄明白真相的强烈渴望。
{{他|她}}观察祭坛，获得一张记载预言的羊皮纸。
新生者将按照预言的启示……
ref_en:
Seek the object of prophecy, glimpse the truth, and escape the nightmare—
<P_Yellow>One object hidden, the sound of the lamb returning home no longer plays.</>
<P_Yellow>One object stored, the seed of rebirth, buried beside the stone statue.</>
<P_Yellow>One object concealed, the crimson moonlight shines upon it.</>
...
...
The newborn is reborn once more.
Nineteen times, {{he|she}} has already died in the dream nineteen times.
This time is {{his|her}} twentieth nightmare.
{{He|She}} opens the Antigonus Notebook, which should not have appeared here.
Then, dies from the loss of control caused by the notebook's power.
The newborn is reborn once more.
This time is {{his|her}} twenty-first nightmare.
...
The newborn sees the Antigonus Notebook again.
{{He|She}} does not open the notebook, but instead draws a ⬛⬛ card.
...
The newborn arrives before the altar filled with flowers and decides to do something.
A strong desire to understand the truth grows within the newborn's heart.
{{He|She}} observes the altar and obtains a piece of parchment recording the prophecy.
The newborn will follow the revelation of the prophecy...

<Highlight>September 12, 21:30—September 13, 12:00</>, the system will perform a unified faction pre-allocation.

<Highlight>September 13, 12:00—September 13, 18:00</>, the 1st place club in each division will be locked and cannot adjust their faction; other clubs can manually adjust their faction. source_cn:
这位“收尸人”的皮肤白皙到像是许久没晒过太阳，或是严重缺血，他大概三十来岁，黑发蓝眼，鼻梁高挺，嘴唇很薄，气质冰冷而阴暗，似乎有些许常年触碰尸体留下的淡薄味道。
　　……
　　这时，一个很像卷烟盒子的锡铁色方形小壶出现在了他的眼前。
　　失去瓶塞的口部散发出类似于烟草、消毒水、薄荷叶等混杂的味道，让克莱恩的鼻子霍然发呛，整个人都精神了起来。
　　浓烈的恶臭依旧缭绕于四周，但克莱恩再不觉得反胃，呕吐很快停止。
　　他顺着那锡铁色方形小壶往上，看见了一只苍白不像活人的手，看见了黑色风衣的袖管，看见了气质冰冷阴暗的“收尸人”弗莱。
　　“谢谢。”克莱恩彻底缓了过来，以手撑膝，重新站起。
　　弗莱没有表情地点了点头：
　　“习惯就好了。”

　　——第一卷《小丑》第四十六章 画像
ref_en:
This "Corpse Collector's" skin was so fair that it looked like he hadn't seen the sun for a long time, or he was severely anemic. He was about thirty years old, with black hair and blue eyes, a high nose bridge, and thin lips. His temperament was cold and dark, and he seemed to have a faint scent left over from years of touching corpses. 
 ... 
 At this moment, a small tin-colored square pot that looked very much like a cigarette case appeared before his eyes. 
 The opening, which had lost its stopper, emitted a smell mixed with tobacco, disinfectant, mint leaves, etc., making Klein's nose suddenly sting and his whole person perk up. 
 The intense stench still lingered in the surroundings, but Klein no longer felt nauseous, and the vomiting stopped quickly. 
 He followed the small tin-colored square pot upward and saw a pale hand that didn't look like a living person's, saw the sleeve of a black trench coat, and saw the cold and dark-tempered "Corpse Collector" Frye. 
 "Thank you." Klein finally recovered completely, supported his knees with his hands, and stood up again. 
 Frye nodded expressionlessly: 
 "You'll get used to it." 
 
 —— Volume 1 "Clown", Chapter 46, Portrait

source_cn:
灰色的麋鹿突然仰首长鸣，它角上的羽毛纷纷发出柔光，飘到空中接续起了戴莉未完成的歌。它的鹿角记住了每片羽毛中储存的音符，它笨拙的收集无意中保存了戴莉所有的歌声。

　　直到鹿角触碰到最后一个音符的时刻，光亮也在出现在眼前，猫头鹰长老在洞口拼命甩着翅膀欢迎英雄的归来。

　　戴莉再次醒来是在温暖而干燥的落叶堆里，它惊讶地发现身上覆盖着全新的羽毛——银白色的，如雾般轻盈蓬松。邓恩安静地守在落叶堆旁，角上依然挂着木牌，最新一块刻着：“戴莉拥有了一身新的羽毛，记得赞美它。”

　　后来，森林里流传着这样的故事：这里有两位守护者，深沉的鹿蹄声和清亮的鸟叫声完美交融，它们在歌声和鹿角中记录每一朵花的绽放，每条溪流的改道和每个生命的成长。邓恩的遗忘还在循环，但它每天都赞美戴莉的羽毛；戴莉的羽毛不再随歌声掉落，每段旋律都让羽毛更有光泽。

　　有些记忆会在冬雪中被埋藏，有些记忆会在回响中永恒。即使遗忘，善良也会为弱者驻足，即使失去，爱会赋予重构的勇气。
ref_en:
The gray elk suddenly raised its head and let out a long cry. The feathers on its antlers emitted a soft light, drifting into the Aerial to continue the song Daly had not finished. Its antlers remembered the notes stored in every feather, and its clumsy collection unintentionally preserved all of Daly's singing.

	Until the moment the antlers touched the last note, the light also appeared before its eyes. The owl elder was flapping its wings desperately at the cave entrance to welcome the hero's return.

	Daly woke up again in a pile of warm and dry fallen leaves. It was surprised to find that it was covered with brand-new feathers—silver-white, as light and fluffy as mist. Dunn was quietly guarding the pile of leaves, with a wooden sign still hanging on his antlers, the latest one carved with: "Daly has a new set of feathers, remember to praise it."

	Later, such a story circulated in the forest: there are two Guardians here, the deep sound of deer hooves and the clear chirping of birds blend perfectly. They record the blooming of every flower, the diversion of every stream, and the growth of every life in their songs and antlers. Dunn's Oblivion is still looping, but he praises Daly's feathers every day; Daly's feathers no longer fall with the singing, and every melody makes the feathers more lustrous.

	Some memories will be buried in the winter snow, and some memories will be eternal in the echoes. Even if forgotten, kindness will stop for the weak; even if lost, love will give the courage to reconstruct.

source_cn:
戴莉·西蒙妮的眼眸碧绿如宝石，却总涂抹着妖异的蓝眼影和腮红，手腕缠绕着挂有白水晶的银链。她是值夜者最年轻的“天才”，三年从序列9走到序列6，自行摸索出扮演法，前途无量。
可每次面对那个温柔的男人，她就变成了最笨拙的学徒。邓恩·史密斯，廷根的值夜者队长，总是把队员护在身后，总是笑着说“没关系”。她那么强，强到能让灵界生物缔结契约，强到能让亡者开口说话，却连一句“我喜欢你”都说不出口。
她被调到贝克兰德教区，离廷根越来越远。本以为自己会忘记，却在每次路过廷根时心跳加速。本以为自己足够强大，却在听到他死讯的那一刻，如同被抽走灵魂。
最后那一战，面对因斯·赞格威尔，她强行与强大的灵界生物缔结契约，濒临失控。她本该逃的，像那些“聪明”人一样。但她没有。
她要——为他报仇。
克莱恩变成邓恩的样子，陪她跳了最后一支舞。她明明知道是假的，却还是笑了。那是她这辈子最幸福的一刻。
ref_en:
Daly Simone's eyes were as green as emeralds, yet she always wore eerie blue eyeshadow and blush, and a silver chain with white crystals wrapped around her wrist. She was the youngest "genius" of the Nighthawks, going from Sequence 9 to Sequence 6 in three years, discovering the Acting method on her own, with a limitless future.
 Yet, every time she faced that gentle man, she became the clumsiest apprentice. Dunn Smith, the captain of the Tingen Nighthawks, always kept his teammates behind him, always smiling and saying "It's okay." She was so strong—strong enough to make contracts with Spirit World creatures, strong enough to make the dead speak—yet she couldn't even say "I like you."
 She was transferred to the Backlund Diocese, further and further away from Tingen. She thought she would forget, but her heart would race every time she passed through Tingen. She thought she was strong enough, but the moment she heard the news of his death, it was as if her soul had been ripped away.
 In that final battle, facing Ince Zangwill, she forcibly made a contract with a powerful Spirit World creature, nearing loss of control. She should have run, like those "smart" people. But she didn't.
 She wanted—to avenge him.
 Klein turned into Dunn's appearance and accompanied her in one last dance. She knew it was fake, but she still smiled. That was the happiest moment of her life.

　　神指的是女神吗？仪式需要的东西倒是很简单，用平时攒下的零花钱就能买全了！

ref_en:
Today I found an old book in those ruins! 
 The book mentions a magic to bring the dead back to life, saying it requires praying to a god through a ritual, using the power of the Tree of Abundance or something. 
 Does the god refer to the Goddess? The things needed for the ritual are quite simple; I can buy them all with the pocket money I've saved up! 
 Just you wait, Little Cloud, when you come back, I will definitely pick the sweetest raspberries for you to eat! 
 I can't tell Mom about this; sigh, she is too prone to making a fuss. 
 When I bring Little Cloud home, she will definitely be shocked, hehe.

source_cn:
一枚由欲望组成的齿轮，咬合着贪婪与痴迷。欲念使者乐意将它送给任何人——反正它总会回到自己手上，浸满持有者的祈求和渴念。
赌徒输光最后一苏勒时摸到了它，商人签完最后一纸契约时攥住了它，没人记得是怎么接过来的，就像没人记得自己什么时候开始渴望。
"再赌一次！就一次！"持有者发抖而偏执的声音总是那么悦耳。
"好啊。"他总是这么回答，微笑着，见证一个又一个人匍匐在他面前，亲吻他的掌心。
持有齿轮的人，总会听到内心渴望的回音，总会与他相遇。
ref_en:
A gear made of desire, interlocking with greed and obsession. The Messenger of Desire is happy to give it to anyone—it always finds its way back to them, soaked in the prayers and cravings of its holder. 
 The gambler touched it when he lost his last sou, and the merchant gripped it when he signed his final contract. No one remembers how they received it, just as no one remembers when they began to crave. 
 "One more bet! Just one more!" The holder's trembling, paranoid voice is always so pleasant. 
 "Very well." He always replies, smiling, witnessing one person after another crawl before him, kissing his palm. 
 Those who hold the gear will always hear the echo of their inner desires and will always meet him.

source_cn: 夜深了，埃尔西娅轻轻关上办公室的门，门外值夜者小队的成员们正欢快地聊天。她的目光投向那表面仿佛镜子的黑色液体。每次晋升都是一场代价是失控的豪赌，但为了守护市民，她必须变强，拥有战胜危险的力量，现在是抉择的时候了。\n深不见底的安静吞没了她，随之而来的是布满每寸皮肤的爆裂之痛。痛苦的呼喊就在喉咙，可她听不见自己的声音。很快，她感受不到自己的身体了，疼痛消失了，恐惧消失了，所有的一切都消失了。她的意识都无法知晓自己赌输了。她不存在了。\n“队长……咦？”清晨时分，年轻人推开房门，没找到队长，却看到了一枚由发丝缠绕而成的简单饰品。它散发着幽深的静谧，让他想起他的队长。
ref_en: The night grew deep, and Elsea gently closed the office door. Outside, the members of the Nighthawks squad were chatting happily. Her gaze turned to the black liquid that looked like a mirror. Every advancement is a gamble where the price is loss of control, but to protect the citizens, she had to become stronger and possess the power to overcome danger. Now was the time for a choice. \n A bottomless silence swallowed her, followed by a bursting pain that covered every inch of her skin. A painful cry was in her throat, but she couldn't hear her own voice. Soon, she could no longer feel her body; the pain vanished, the fear vanished, and everything disappeared. Her consciousness couldn't even know that she had lost the gamble. She ceased to exist. \n "Captain... huh?" In the early morning, a young man pushed open the door and didn't find the captain, but saw a simple accessory made of braided hair. It radiated a profound tranquility, reminding him of his captain.

4、烙印装备的讨伐奖励次数增加规则：共次数的副本，共享讨伐奖励次数，每周每个首领增加1次

ref_en:
1. Each dungeon will receive a certain number of <Highlight>Crusade Reward Counts</> every week. Players will increase their <Highlight>Crusade Reward Progress</> after killing the dungeon boss. 
2. After the <Highlight>Crusade Reward Progress</> is fully accumulated, you can claim a piece of <Highlight>unowned Imprint Equipment or cosmetic reward</> from the current dungeon. 
3. After claiming, the corresponding progress will deduct the number of counts required for claiming the reward. 
4. Imprint Equipment Crusade Reward Count increase rule: Dungeons with shared counts share Crusade Reward Counts, and each boss adds 1 count per week. 
5. Cosmetic Crusade Reward Count increase rule: Each dungeon adds 2 counts per boss per week, and Normal and Hard difficulties share counts.

减免所受伤害的技能基础值，抵消伤害来源的技能增强。
技能基础值不受<Highlight>攻击</>和<Highlight>防御</>影响，取决于<Highlight>技能系数</>和<Highlight>技能等级</>。
修正后的技能基础值存在<Highlight>250%</>的上限和<Highlight>5%</>的下限，提升的技能抵挡超出上阈值或未到下阈值时，无法提升减伤能力。

ref_en:
Reduces the base Skill value of received damage, offsetting the damage source's Skill Enhancement. 
 The base Skill value is not affected by <Highlight> Attack </> and <Highlight> Defense </>, but depends on <Highlight> Skill Coefficient </> and <Highlight> Skill Level </>. 
 The corrected base Skill value has an upper limit of <Highlight> 250% </> and a lower limit of <Highlight> 5% </>; if the increased Skill Block exceeds the upper threshold or fails to reach the lower threshold, it cannot improve damage reduction capability. 
 The actual effect and thresholds depend on the Level <Highlight> </> of both the attacker and defender, and the confrontation settlement with the opponent's <Highlight> Skill Enhancement </> attribute.

source_cn:
在黎明降临之前，因蒂斯被历史的阴影和现实的纷争笼罩。
        直到1173年，罗塞尔·古斯塔夫高举革新的火光，带领这个国家走入了新的时代。他为这片混乱的土地带来新的秩序、律法与文明，将旧时代的腐朽肮脏全部涤清。
        新的法律开始保障工人权益，义务教育让孩子们走入学堂，高等学校统一考试为国家培养人才，国家债券与基金的设立让因蒂斯的经济又一次复苏运转。《民法典》的光辉照耀在每个人的身上，就像破开迷雾的太阳。
        因蒂斯首都特里尔又一次被欢笑与鲜花环绕，让我们赞美——
        伟大的因蒂斯共和国！伟大的共和国执政官罗塞尔！
ref_en:
Before the dawn arrived, Intis was shrouded in the shadows of history and the disputes of reality. 
 Until 1173, Roselle Gustav held high the torch of innovation and led this country into a new era. He brought new order, laws, and civilization to this chaotic land, cleansing all the decay and filth of the old era. 
 New laws began to protect the rights of workers, compulsory education allowed children to enter schools, unified entrance examinations for higher education cultivated talents for the country, and the establishment of national bonds and funds allowed the Intis economy to recover and operate once again. The brilliance of the Civil Code shone upon everyone, like the sun breaking through the fog. 
 The Intis capital, Trier, was once again surrounded by laughter and flowers. Let us praise— 
 The great Intis Republic! The great Republic Consul Roselle!

Due to the different sequences and quantities of Beyonder characteristics that compose them, Beyonder materials vary in the number, type, and strength of their entries. 1.如果在梯子脚下出现了齿轮堆，剪断第一根线。

ref_en:
1. If a pile of gears appears under the ladder, cut the first wire. 
 2. If all three wires are blue, cut the second wire. 
 3. If there is a red light at the door and there are two or more red wires, cut the second wire. 
 4. If there is only one green wire, cut this wire. 
 5. If none of the above conditions are met, cut the third wire.

At this moment, Dunn Smith turned his head to look at Klein, his pale face wearing a gentle and relaxed smile, his voice as mellow as ever:
 "We saved Tingen."
 After saying this, he seemed to return to the year he was twenty, no longer as steady or serious as he winked at Klein with his left eye.
 Klein's expression froze on his face. He saw the heart inside Saint Selena's urn stop beating, turn into brilliant points of light, and dissipate into the surroundings. He saw the captain's body fall backward, his hands loosening.
 Everything was like a series of composed frames, yet one that no one could stop.

 — Volume 1: Clown, Chapter 211: Light

source_cn:
梅丽莎深深看了他一眼，忽地转身，小跑步进了里间，拿出一个由齿轮、锈铁、弹簧和发条等拼凑成的乌龟状物品。
快速扭紧发条，梅丽莎将这物品放在了书桌上。
       咔咔咔，哒哒哒，那“乌龟”一跳一走，很有节律，让人不由自主就将注意力转移到了它身上。
       “感觉烦恼的时候，看着它这么动一动，会舒服很多，我最近经常这样，很有效的！克莱恩，你试一试。”梅丽莎眸光明亮地邀请道。
       克莱恩没拒绝妹妹的好意，凑近看着那“乌龟”，等到它停止才笑道：
       “简单和规律确实能带来放松。”
       不等梅丽莎再说，他指着“乌龟”，随口问道：
       “自己做的？什么时候做的？我怎么不知道？”
       “我用学校不要的材料和路上捡到的东西做的，前两天才弄好。”梅丽莎表情如常，嘴角翘了几分。
       “很厉害啊。”克莱恩由衷赞道。
       作为一名在机械方面动手能力差的男孩子，他小时候拼个四驱车都要死要活。
       梅丽莎下巴微抬，眼睛略弯，语气平淡地回答：
       “还好，还好。”
       “过分的谦虚是坏品格。”克莱恩轻笑道，“这是只乌龟吧？”
       房间内的气氛突然沉凝了一下，梅丽莎的嗓音幽幽如同绯红轻纱般响起：
       “它是人偶。”

       ——第一卷《小丑》第十六章 狗拿耗子
ref_en:
Melissa looked at him deeply, suddenly turned around, trotted into the inner room, and took out a turtle-shaped object pieced together from gears, rusty iron, springs, and clockwork. 
 Quickly tightening the clockwork, Melissa placed the object on the desk. 
 Click, click, click, da, da, da, the “turtle” jumped and walked, very rhythmic, making people involuntarily shift their attention to it. 
 “When you feel troubled, watching it move like this will make you feel much better. I’ve been doing this a lot lately, it’s very effective! Klein, you try it.” Melissa invited with bright eyes. 
 Klein didn’t refuse his sister’s kindness, leaned close to watch the “turtle,” and didn’t smile until it stopped: 
 “Simplicity and regularity can indeed bring relaxation.” 
 Without waiting for Melissa to say more, he pointed to the “turtle” and asked casually: 
 “Did you make it yourself? When did you make it? Why didn’t I know?” 
 “I made it with materials the school didn’t want and things I picked up on the road. I just finished it two days ago.” Melissa’s expression was as usual, the corners of her mouth raised a little. 
 “That’s amazing.” Klein praised sincerely. 
 As a boy with poor hands-on ability in mechanics, he struggled to assemble a four-wheel drive car when he was a child. 
 Melissa raised her chin slightly, her eyes curved slightly, and she replied in a flat tone: 
 “It’s okay, it’s okay.” 
 “Excessive modesty is a bad character.” Klein chuckled, “This is a turtle, right?” 
 The atmosphere in the room suddenly condensed, and Melissa’s voice sounded like crimson gauze: 
 “It’s a doll.” 
 
 —— Volume 1: Clown, Chapter 16: A Dog Catching a Mouse

source_cn: 【死亡永渡】为限时结交人脉活动。 活动期间，阿兹克·艾格斯结交概率大幅提升。当获得传说人脉时，80%概率为阿兹克·艾格斯。如果本次结交的传说人脉不是阿兹克·艾格斯，则下次结交获得传说人脉时必定为阿兹克·艾格斯。 概率信息</> <Highlight>[传说]</>品质人脉：基础概率为1.5%，综合概率（含保底）为3.74% 包含：阿兹克·艾格斯、克莱恩·莫雷蒂、奥黛丽·霍尔、伦纳德·米切尔、佛尔思·沃尔、邓恩·史密斯、戴莉·西蒙妮、阿尔杰·威尔逊 <Highlight>[史诗]</>品质人脉：基础概率为10%，综合概率（含保底）为22.56% 包含：苏茜、洛薇雅·蒂芙尼、老尼尔、弗莱、弗兰克·李、班森·莫雷蒂、梅丽莎·莫雷蒂 <Highlight>[常规道具]相关</>：基础概率为88.5%，综合概率（含保底）为73.70% 包含：基础物质、聚合因子 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>结交细则</> 1、每5次结交，必定获得一位史诗或以上的人脉。 2、如果连续24次结交未获得传说人脉，则后续概率逐渐提升。 每40次结交必定获得传说人脉。 获得传说人脉后计数重置，概率恢复为基础概率。 3、【死亡永渡】的保底次数会一直累积在限时结交活动中，与常驻结交活动独立计算互不影响。 4、限时结交活动每日可获得100次结交次数，最多可累计至700次。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>重复获得人脉</> 重复获得相同传说人脉时，将转化为1个对应人脉提升材料和10个投影片段。如果该传说人脉已经达到极致或材料足以提升至极致，多余的提升材料会转化为40个投影片段。 重复获得相同史诗人脉时，将转化为1个对应人脉提升材料和2个投影片段。如果该史诗人脉已经达到极致或材料足以提升至极致，多余的提升材料会转化为2个投影片段。 投影片段可用于在人脉商店兑换道具。
ref_en: [Death's Eternal Crossing] is a limited-time Befriending Connections activity. During the activity, the Befriending probability of Azik Eggers is greatly increased. When you obtain a Legendary Connection, there is an 80% probability that it is Azik Eggers. If the Legendary Connection obtained this time is not Azik Eggers, the next Legendary Connection obtained is guaranteed to be Azik Eggers. Probability Information </> <Highlight> [Legendary] </> Quality Connection: Base probability is 1.5%, comprehensive probability (including pity) is 3.74%. Includes: Azik Eggers, Klein Moretti, Audrey Hall, Leonard Mitchell, Fors Wall, Dunn Smith, Daly Simone, Alger Wilson. <Highlight> [Epic] </> Quality Connection: Base probability is 10%, comprehensive probability (including pity) is 22.56%. Includes: Susie, Lovia Tiffany, Old Neil, Frye, Frank Lee, Benson Moretti, Melissa Moretti. <Highlight> [General Items] Related </>: Base probability is 88.5%, comprehensive probability (including pity) is 73.70%. Includes: Basic Materials, Aggregation Factors. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/> <Title> Befriending Details </> 1. Every 5 Befriending attempts, you are guaranteed to obtain a Connection of Epic quality or higher. 2. If you do not obtain a Legendary Connection in 24 consecutive Befriending attempts, the subsequent probability will gradually increase. You are guaranteed to obtain a Legendary Connection every 40 Befriending attempts. After obtaining a Legendary Connection, the count resets, and the probability returns to the base probability. 3. The pity count for [Death's Eternal Crossing] will always accumulate in the limited-time Befriending activity and is calculated independently of the permanent Befriending activity, not affecting each other. 4. In the limited-time Befriending activity, you can obtain 100 Befriending attempts per day, which can be accumulated up to 700 times. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/> <Title> Repeatedly Obtaining Connections </> When you repeatedly obtain the same Legendary Connection, it will be converted into 1 corresponding Connection improvement material and 10 Projection Fragments. If that Legendary Connection has already reached the ultimate level or the materials are sufficient to upgrade it to the ultimate level, the excess improvement materials will be converted into 40 Projection Fragments. When you repeatedly obtain the same Epic Connection, it will be converted into 1 corresponding Connection improvement material and 2 Projection Fragments. If that Epic Connection has already reached the ultimate level or the materials are sufficient to upgrade it to the ultimate level, the excess improvement materials will be converted into 2 Projection Fragments. Projection Fragments can be used to exchange for items in the Connection Shop.

source_cn:
（一）
我们是5月23日上午上山的，上山的时候碰到了一个穿着整齐西装的男人，四十来岁的样子，他向我们询问下山的路，给我感觉像城堡里的伯爵先生一样，佐治将下山的路告诉给他。没走两步，我回头，他消失不见了。
佐治说要学习搭帐篷，我给他示范了三次，最后反倒是我被帐篷难倒了，这新买的帐篷不太顶用。

物资：
面包——8余6
肉类制品——6余5
糖——1罐约1磅
黄油——4余4
酒——4余3
水——5余5 明天留意水源

（二）
今天是晴天，雪很刺眼。
佐治每隔一段时间就要看他的那本登山日志，像个老道的登山者一样，物资的记录就交给他了。
其实他这是第二次跟我登山，上一次我跟他走的是古堡附近的野山。

（三）
今天是赶路的一天，我们必须赶在明天前抵达山顶，否则物资会不够。
晚上，我发现扎营的地方附近有水源，很幸运，我们暂时不缺水了。
但我隐约感觉有“野兽”在注视我们的帐篷，今晚只好我来守夜了。

（四）
在山上找到了一颗琥珀，把佐治羡慕坏了。这是我在霍纳奇斯登山以来最特殊的一个登顶纪念品。
奇怪的是，这颗琥珀是从什么时候到我手里的？我为什么会不记得？
琥珀里还有一只小虫子，听说琥珀里面的虫子可是跨越了千万年时间的“时间旅客”？千万年前的虫子长这样？

（五）
珀琥是不本根那
ref_en:
(I) 
 We went up the mountain on the morning of May 23rd. On the way up, we met a man in a neat suit, about forty years old. He asked us for the way down. He gave me the feeling of a Count in a castle. George told him the way down. We hadn't walked two steps when I looked back, and he had disappeared. 
 George said he wanted to learn how to set up a tent. I demonstrated it to him three times, but in the end, I was the one stumped by the tent. This newly bought tent isn't very useful. 

 Supplies: 
 Bread—8 left 6 
 Meat products—6 left 5 
 Sugar—1 jar about 1 lb 
 Butter—4 left 4 
 Alcohol—4 left 3 
 Water—5 left 5 Keep an eye on water sources tomorrow 

 (II) 
 Today is a sunny day, the snow is blinding. 
 George checks his mountaineering log every so often, like an experienced mountaineer. The recording of supplies is left to him. 
 Actually, this is his second time mountaineering with me. Last time, I walked the wild mountains near the ancient castle with him. 

 (III) 
 Today was a day of rushing. We must reach the summit before tomorrow, otherwise, the supplies won't be enough. 
 In the evening, I found a water source near the campsite. Fortunately, we are not short of water for now. 
 But I vaguely feel that a "beast" is watching our tent. I have to stand guard tonight. 

 (IV) 
 Found an amber on the mountain, which made George very envious. This is the most special souvenir I've had since mountaineering in Hornacis. 
 The strange thing is, when did this amber get into my hands? Why don't I remember? 
 There is a small bug in the amber. I heard that the bugs in amber are "time travelers" that have spanned millions of years? Do bugs from millions of years ago look like this? 

 (V) 
 Amber is not...

source_cn:
伯德温·威瑟尔留下的无数遗产中，最珍贵的当属他的铠甲·伊桑——是他亲自取的名字，含义为坚强不屈的灵魂。
伯德温生前的最后一句话是：“我死后，非凡特性要留给伊桑。序列5的收割者足以让它获得灵性，继承我的意志，成为真正的……”
不朽的、家族守护者。
伯德温停止呼吸后，铠甲动了，在一众悲痛和敬畏中，行了一个标准的骑士礼。
就这样，先祖铠甲世世代代守护威瑟尔家族，利剑出鞘，不死不休。直到数年前，一种强大又可怕的力量浸染了庄园，污染了铠甲。
那一夜，铠甲屠戮了整个家族。
它背叛了坚守600年的意志，它成为了家族覆灭的罪人。它同它的罪恶一起被掩埋入大地深处，直到许多年后，有人再次唤醒它。
“为我所用吧，伊桑。”
来自威瑟尔家族最后的血脉，同时也是那种强大力量的眷顾者。
“用你不朽的意志，来守护我的儿子……和一切吧。”
ref_en:
Among the countless legacies left by Baldwin Wetherell, the most precious is his armor, Ethan—a name he chose himself, meaning a strong and unyielding soul. 
 Baldwin's last words before he died were: "After I die, the Beyonder characteristic must be left to Ethan. A Sequence 5 Reaper is enough to give it spirituality, inherit my will, and become a true..." 
 Immortal, family Guardian. 
 After Baldwin stopped breathing, the armor moved and, amidst the grief and awe of the crowd, performed a standard knight's salute. 
 Thus, the Ancestor Armor guarded the Wetherell family for generations, sword drawn, never dying, never resting. Until a few years ago, a powerful and terrifying force permeated the manor, corrupting the armor. 
 That night, the armor slaughtered the entire family. 
 It betrayed the will it had upheld for 600 years; it became the sinner of the family's destruction. It was buried deep in the earth along with its sins, until many years later, someone awakened it again. 
 "Be used by me, Ethan." 
 From the last bloodline of the Wetherell family, who was also the favored one of that powerful force. 
 "Use your immortal will to guard my son... and everything else."

ref_en: Well... I have my own ways, at least enough to ensure you don't get lost. Are you willing to trust me?

source_cn: 这个承载着爱与希望的口风琴和乐谱，是他留给你的祝福。
ref_en: This harmonica and score, carrying love and hope, are his blessings to you.

source_cn: 这幅肖像画的是一位贝克兰德的聪慧上班族。
ref_en: This portrait depicts a clever office worker from Backlund.

Pan-fried Meat with White Herb Sauce

source_cn: <P_Heart>（5镑？！几乎是我两周的薪水……而且最近刚搬完家，交完租金后，手里剩下了不到2镑。）</>
ref_en: <P_Heart>(5 pounds?! That's almost two weeks of my salary... and I just moved recently; after paying the rent, I have less than 2 pounds left.)</>

ref_en: Don't rush, {{he|she}} just finished drinking the Sequence 9 potion and still needs to adapt.

ref_en: Miss Magician has asked you to pass a newly released novel to Mr. Moon.
...It's fine, maybe I've been resting too little lately.
[Roadblock] Road blocked behind the main road

source_cn: 【风闻】梦魇命中目标后在目标处生成仪式魔法，仪式魔法持续6秒，仪式魔法每秒对范围内的敌人造成伤害。
ref_en: [Rumor] After Nightmare hits a target, it generates a Ritual Magic at the target's location. The Ritual Magic lasts 6 seconds and deals damage to enemies within range every second.

source_cn: 五维增加*d点，持续1800秒（训练场试用药）。
ref_en: Increase all five stats by *d points, lasts 1800 seconds (Training Ground trial potion).

source_cn: 从这根木板走过来的，这就是我的练习场。
ref_en: I walked over on this wooden plank. This is my practice area.

source_cn: 他从教会偷走了怨魂晶石，看来是为晋升为“怨魂”做准备。
ref_en: He stole the Wraith crystal from the Church; it seems he is preparing to advance to "Wraith".

source_cn: 以前这叫维尔的餐厅，时间可过得真快，现在都成老维尔餐厅了。
ref_en: It used to be called Will's Restaurant. Time really flies; now it's become Old Will's Restaurant.
But he is the most generous with credits!

source_cn: 作为新员工，你表现很不错。
ref_en: As a new employee, you performed very well.
Look at who I am again!

source_cn: 你怎么突然开始发呆了？
ref_en: Why did you suddenly start spacing out?

source_cn: 你是……不，您、您是占卜师吗！
ref_en: Are you... no, are you a diviner?

source_cn: 先是一阵虚幻的破碎声，接着我感受到有东西在溶解，和我的精神慢慢融合……
ref_en: First, there was an illusory sound of shattering, then I felt something dissolving and slowly merging with my spirit...

source_cn: 其实，我就是那个俱乐部的成员。
ref_en: Actually, I am a member of that club.

source_cn: 别提了！这几天膝盖疼得像被马车碾过一样，我那儿子非让我在家躺着。这不，刚能走路，我就来了。
ref_en: Don't mention it! My knees have been hurting like they were crushed by a carriage for the past few days, and my son insisted I stay in bed. That's why I'm only coming out now that I can walk.

source_cn: 可以这么说，我希望我足够强大，可以守护想守护的一切。但除此之外……我还有另一个理由。
ref_en: You could say that. I hope I am strong enough to protect everything I want to protect. But besides that... I have another reason.

source_cn: 听着，“罪恶廷根”是所有人憋在心里的烂摊子具象化出来的城市暗面，像不像见不得光的下水道？
ref_en: Listen, "Sinful Tingen" is the dark side of the city, a manifestation of the mess everyone keeps bottled up inside. Doesn't it look like a sewer that can't see the light?

source_cn: 听起来是个宏大的议题。
因为当时第1把我没带手杖
ref_en: Because I didn't bring my cane in the first round.

source_cn: 在目标逃跑前尽可能的对他造成更多的伤害！
ref_en: Deal as much damage as possible to the target before they escape!

source_cn: 在酒吧内打听到相应线索
ref_en: Gather relevant clues in the bar

source_cn: 学校就不能给我们没中签的发租房补贴吗？我哪有时间去打工赚钱……
ref_en: Can't the school give us rent subsidies if we didn't win the lottery? Where would I find the time to work and earn money...

source_cn: 完成丰饶之树黄铜书挑战【三色迷舞·困难】
ref_en: Complete the Tree of Abundance Brass Book challenge [Three-Colored Maze Dance · Hard]

source_cn: 完成通用条件表  切换HUD顶栏显示模式  玩家播放仅自己可见的说话文本  延迟执行  玩家播放仅自己可见的说话文本
ref_en: Complete the general conditions table. Switch HUD top bar display mode. Player plays speech text visible only to themselves. Delayed execution. Player plays speech text visible only to themselves.

source_cn: 当时他认为我被2-049控制，于是用解救我并给予“占卜家”途径对应的序列8“小丑”来引诱我，让我去拿安提哥努斯笔记。
ref_en: At the time, he thought I was controlled by 2-049, so he tried to lure me by rescuing me and offering the Sequence 8 Clown of the Seer pathway, making me go get the Antigonus notebook.

source_cn: 当然是世界越来越混乱了。再这样下去，廷根需要第二所精神病院。愿女神庇佑我们……教会应该加强力量，保护我们这些可怜的羔羊。
ref_en: Of course, the world is becoming more and more chaotic. If this continues, Tingen will need a second mental hospital. May the Goddess protect us... The Church should strengthen its power to protect us poor lambs.
Your Power Punch skill has been strengthened.

source_cn: 我一直在等你开口。但你太固执了。你说，一个仆人没资格提要求。
ref_en: I was always waiting for you to ask. But you were too stubborn. You said a servant had no right to make requests.

source_cn: 我们走吧，还得下几层楼梯。
ref_en: Let's go, we still have to go down a few flights of stairs.

source_cn: 托马斯神父忽然出现在拉姆德小镇，而且对受害者们格外关心。
ref_en: Father Thomas suddenly appeared in Lamud Town and was exceptionally concerned about the victims.

source_cn: 按照这些主题，糊弄两句报纸上那些政客的废话，就没问题。记住，千万要<P_Yellow>选对主题</>！
ref_en: Follow these themes and spout some nonsense like the politicians in the newspapers, and it'll be fine. Remember, you must <P_Yellow>choose the right theme</>!

source_cn: 支线·美梦成真·第二章第1段
ref_en: Side Quest: Dreams Come True, Chapter 2, Paragraph 1

source_cn: 敢不敢去打一场？能力和勇气比警徽更有说服力。
ref_en: Do you dare to have a fight? Ability and courage are more convincing than a police badge.

source_cn: 时间过得好快，转眼间到这个时候了。
ref_en: Time passes so quickly, it's this time already in the blink of an eye.

source_cn: 是否要清空当前频道消息？
ref_en: Do you want to clear the current channel messages?

source_cn: 晒干研磨后的金手柑，具有提振精神与增强仪式清醒度的作用。
ref_en: Dried and ground bergamot, which has the effect of uplifting the spirit and enhancing ritual clarity.

source_cn: 某站点铁矿石限时打折出售
ref_en: Iron ore at a certain station is on limited-time discount sale

source_cn: 梅丽莎从小喜欢齿轮、发条、轴承等事物，现在是廷根技术学校蒸汽与机械系的学生，立志要做一名蒸汽机械师。她平时经常在路上捡东西，再跟学校不要的材料一起，拼拼凑凑就能做出些有趣的小机关。\n\n这个机关盒被她用来装家里珍贵的小物件，虽然班森和克莱恩一致认为这机关盒是最珍贵的东西。
ref_en: Melissa has loved gears, springs, and bearings since she was a child and is now a student in the Steam and Machinery Department at the Tingen Technical School, aspiring to be a steam mechanic. She often picks up things on the road and combines them with materials discarded by the school to make interesting little gadgets. \n\n She uses this gadget box to store precious small items from home, although Benson and Klein both agree that the gadget box itself is the most precious thing.

source_cn: 欢迎回来，领主大人！您可以自由地建设和装修城堡，进行工坊生产和市场交易，或是发起铁路贸易。在您的带领下，城堡正在被建设得越来越好。
ref_en: Welcome back, Lord! You can freely build and decorate the castle, engage in workshop production and market trading, or initiate railway trade. Under your leadership, the castle is being built better and better.

source_cn: 正在收集溢出灵性的某位值夜者，可用收集到的异象之物兑换奖励。
ref_en: A Nighthawk collecting overflowing spirituality; you can exchange collected Objects of Phenomenon for rewards.

source_cn: 灿烂的正午阳光洒满宁静的公园，驱散了所有的阴霾。
ref_en: The brilliant midday sun bathes the quiet park, dispelling all gloom.

source_cn: 算。但有钱就能摆平。<P_Heart>（叹气）</>剧院要的是叫座的名字，谁在乎剧本是谁写的？
ref_en: It is. But money can smooth anything over. <P_Heart>(Sighs)</> The theater wants a name that sells tickets; who cares who actually wrote the script?

source_cn: 红色的部位……是它们的帽子！
ref_en: The red part... is their hat!

source_cn: 荒废的地下遗迹中，邪教徒仍在徘徊。当你踏入陷阱的那一刻，亡者已然睁眼。
ref_en: In the abandoned underground ruins, cultists still wander. The moment you step into a trap, the dead have already opened their eyes.

source_cn: 走吧，带上你的“亲爱的”，和这位帮我找到你的{{哥哥|姐姐}}道谢，我们回家。
ref_en: Let's go. Take your "dear" and thank this {{brother|sister}} who helped me find you, and let's go home.

source_cn: 那外表斯文有礼，行动却疯狂的冒险家，有着令四王七将都恐惧的名字——格尔曼！没错，就是他，大冒险家，疯狂的海盗猎人，格尔曼·斯帕罗！
ref_en: That adventurer who looks gentle and polite but acts like a madman has a name that makes the Four Kings and Seven Generals fear him—Gehrman! That's right, it's him, the great adventurer, the mad pirate hunter, Gehrman Sparrow!

source_cn: 那屋里的动静……今晚又该睡不着了。
ref_en: The commotion in that room... I won't be able to sleep again tonight.

source_cn: 阀门被击毁！核心失去5%的生命
ref_en: The valve has been destroyed! The core loses 5% of its Health.

source_cn: 需要帮您提行李吗？我对这边很熟悉的。
ref_en: Do you need help with your luggage? I am very familiar with this area.
What kind of flowers do you want to buy?

source_cn:
<Assistant_Title1>【City of Shadows】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Introduction: </>Under the guidance of Miss Justice, you enter a world formed by the collective subconscious of Tingen. Everything that happens here will not have a direct impact on reality. However, clearing the malice in the subconscious will disturb the source of reality. Delve into the event scenes, complete plot, challenge, and competition events to save this city.
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Guide: </>
1. Complete the <Assistant_System>"Sinful Tingen"</> plot to unlock the system; open the map, switch to the Exploration tab, switch to the "City of Shadows" tab, select an unlocked event icon on the map, and click to automatically navigate to the target.
2. Arrive at the designated area and use methods such as talking to relevant NPCs to start the event.
3. Complete to {SendAnswer:事件|877}obtain relevant rewards.
<Assistant_Title2>Scene Features: </>
Entering Sinful Tingen, vehicle control is in realistic driving mode.
<Assistant_Title2>Beginner Tips: </>
1. It is recommended to prioritize completing the main plot events in Sinful Tingen upon first entry to unlock more gameplay.
2. The <Assistant_Red>Fierce Battle · Bonnie</> event requires reaching the recommended Beyonder rating and level.
3. Limited-time multiplayer competition events are open daily; compete with other players to win ranking rewards.

source_cn: <P_Heart>（哼歌）</>祝你生日快乐，祝你生日快乐，祝亲爱的詹森生日快乐。
ref_en: <P_Heart>(Humming)</> Happy birthday to you, happy birthday to you, happy birthday to dear Jensen.

source_cn: <P_Heart>（摇头）</>（指向玩家）不，这次就让这位{{先生|女士}}来写吧。可以吗？
ref_en: <P_Heart>(Shaking head)</> (Pointing at the player) No, let this {{Mr.|Ms.}} write this time. Is that alright?

source_cn: <P_Heart>（梅丽莎刚才看我的眼神，像是在关爱智障哥哥。）</>
ref_en: <P_Heart>(The look Melissa just gave me was like she was pitying her mentally challenged brother.)</>

source_cn: AI语音捏脸，语音转文字敏感词检查
ref_en: AI Voice Face Sculpting, Voice-to-Text Sensitive Word Check

source_cn: “安提科勋爵的负债花销和不经营产业是为了维持贵族的体面，这很常见。不允许售卖酒庄里的酒只是因为喜欢美酒，不允许妻子卖酒也可以说成是对妻子的珍视，没有出轨行为，这怎么能算背叛了婚姻呢？”几位律师都是这样的答复。
ref_en: "Lord Antigonus's debts and lack of business management were merely to maintain the dignity of a nobleman; this is quite common. Not allowing the sale of wine from the winery was simply because he loved fine wine, and forbidding his wife from selling wine can also be described as cherishing her. There was no infidelity, so how can this be considered a betrayal of marriage?" These were the replies from several lawyers.
[North District Atmosphere] Harold Department Store Security
Communicate in a friendly manner with the <h>kitten</>
Give to the mysterious old man.

source_cn: 他们会重新在廷根投资，把大把的金镑贡献给政府，让我们赢下所有交易。
ref_en: They will reinvest in Tingen, contribute piles of gold pounds to the government, and let us win every transaction.

source_cn: 你已成祂，以途径为名，以权能为身，支配某一领域的神性法则。

source_cn:
洛薇雅不是一个喜欢解释的人。
她有一头银灰的卷发，一双淡灰的眼眸，眉眼大气艳丽，却常年沉默。她是六人议事团最年轻的长老，本该前途无量，却选择了一条所有人都不理解的路——成为“牧羊人”，信仰那个被称为邪神的真实造物主。
族人说她疯了，说她背叛了白银城，说她与黑暗为伍。她从不辩解，只是每次探索神弃之地时，依然冲在最前面；每次黑暗深处的危险降临，依然挡在队友身前。
她很少说话，但每次议事团做出危险的决定，她总是第一个点头。每次需要有人深入黑暗探路，她总是第一个起身。
在极光会的帮助下，她晋升为黑骑士。更强的力量，也意味着更深的误解。有人说她彻底堕落了，有人说她早已不是原来的洛薇雅。
直到巨人王庭那一战。神圣的火光从天而降，灼烧她的血肉，泯灭她的灵魂。
“我没有背叛白银城。”
这是她留下的最后一句话。
在永恒的黑暗里，不是每个人都能被阳光照耀。有的人只是用自己的方式寻找光，哪怕那光在别人眼里是罪恶。
ref_en:
Lovia is not a person who likes to explain. 
 She has a head of silver-gray curly hair, a pair of light gray eyes, and grand, beautiful features, yet she is often silent. She is the youngest elder of the Six-Member Council and should have had a bright future, but she chose a path that no one understood—becoming a "Shepherd" and believing in the True Creator, who is called an evil god. 
 Her clansmen say she is crazy, that she betrayed the City of Silver, and that she walks with darkness. She never defends herself, but every time she explores the Forsaken Land of the Gods, she is still at the forefront; every time danger from the depths of darkness descends, she still stands in front of her teammates. 
 She rarely speaks, but every time the Council makes a dangerous decision, she is always the first to nod. Every time someone needs to go deep into the darkness to scout, she is always the first to stand up. 
 With the help of the Aurora Order, she was promoted to a Black Knight. Greater power also meant deeper misunderstanding. Some say she has completely fallen, and some say she is no longer the original Lovia. 
 Until that battle at the Giant King's Court. Holy fire descended from the sky, burning her flesh and extinguishing her soul. 
 "I did not betray the City of Silver." 
 This was the last sentence she left behind. 
 In the eternal darkness, not everyone can be illuminated by the sun. Some people just find light in their own way, even if that light is seen as sin by others.

source_cn:
5月24日
晴天。
　　雪面反射的阳光非常刺眼，为了避免眼睛遭罪，我建议尼尔太阳落山后再出发。他没把我的话放在心上，自顾自地收拾东西，然后先走了——他总是这样。
　　我把东西收拾好追上他，远远望去，他在雪地里的影子竟有五个，朝五个方向散开。
　　可能是我看错了，再望过去，只剩一个。我们在山腰的位置扎营，距离登顶应该不远了。
ref_en:
May 24th 
 Sunny. 
　　The sunlight reflected off the snow is very blinding. To avoid hurting our eyes, I suggested to Neil that we set off after sunset. He didn't take my words to heart, packed his things on his own, and left first—he is always like this. 
　　I packed my things and caught up with him. Looking from afar, he actually had five shadows in the snow, spreading out in five directions. 
　　Maybe I saw wrong. Looking again, there was only one. We camped at the mountainside; we shouldn't be far from the summit.

source_cn:
“美丽的女士，你刻意留下的破绽实在拙劣。不过，这种小聪明倒让我更感兴趣了，卢娜女士。”
“可当她垂下眼眸，那一举一动纯洁无辜，风情万种却又不曾察觉，真是……真是天生的尤物啊。陷阱又如何？我当然有分寸。让这场考验来得更猛烈些吧……”
“清晨的阳光洒在她的脸上，多么美好，我望向床边的镜子，一切如同油画一般……等等，镜子里是个……男人？！难道这是……传说中的魔女？！”
“但看着这张脸，谁能说她不比真正的女人更动人？我的心里慢慢生出了别样的滋味……”
“魔女的滋味……确实不错。”
ref_en:
"Beautiful lady, the flaw you deliberately left is truly clumsy. However, this kind of cleverness makes me even more interested, Ms. Luna." 
"But when she lowered her eyes, every movement was pure and innocent, charming and yet unaware—truly... truly a natural femme fatale. So what if it's a trap? I naturally have my own sense of proportion. Let this test come even more fiercely..." 
"The morning sunlight spilled onto her face, how wonderful. I looked at the mirror by the bed, everything was like an oil painting... Wait, is that a... man in the mirror?! Could this be... the legendary Witch?!" 
"But looking at this face, who could say she isn't more moving than a real woman? A different kind of taste slowly grew in my heart..." 
"The taste of the Witch... is indeed not bad."

source_cn: 恭喜你，成功重历了一次我的历史，感觉怎么样？
ref_en: Congratulations, you have successfully relived my history once. How do you feel?

source_cn: 感谢您的介绍，您知道乔纳尔医生家在哪里吗？
ref_en: Thank you for the introduction. Do you know where Dr. Jonar lives?

source_cn: 愿你和那位存在一样，在这座学识之都度过旅行开端最好的时光。
ref_en: May you, like that existence, spend the best time at the beginning of your journey in this city of knowledge.

source_cn: 我希望您能帮我发掘这座城市里更多的幽默，我会给您相应的报酬。
ref_en: I hope you can help me discover more humor in this city, and I will give you the corresponding reward.

source_cn: 我怀疑这本笔记是具备一定生命和智慧的邪恶物品。
ref_en: I suspect this notebook is an evil item possessing a certain degree of life and intelligence.

source_cn: 我需要帮你保管一下，不然它持续抽取你的灵性，你一定会彻底失控的。
ref_en: I need to keep it for you; otherwise, it will continue to drain your spirituality, and you will definitely lose control completely.

source_cn: 打开后可以自选获得<Highlight>62装等</>的<Highlight>竞技倾向</>橙色烙印装备。
ref_en: After opening, you can choose to receive a piece of <Highlight>Level 62</> <Highlight>Competition-oriented</> orange Brand Equipment.

source_cn: 技能tag和对应的提升攻速倍率
ref_en: Skill tag and corresponding attack speed boost multiplier.

source_cn: 捡到一只保养良好的怀表，它的主人会在哪里？
ref_en: Found a well-maintained pocket watch. Where could its owner be?

source_cn: 文案<LuxuryPartyName>玩家名称</>文案文案
新增Action都往上面添加，这些占位Action务必保持在表格最下方
ref_en: New Actions should be added to the top; these placeholder Actions must remain at the bottom of the table.

source_cn: 有心跳了——呼吸也恢复了！
ref_en: There's a heartbeat—and her breathing has recovered!

source_cn: 来都来了，今天体验一下二人世界？不告诉肯和萨拉他们。
ref_en: Since you're already here, why not experience some time for two today? Let's not tell Ken and Sarah.

source_cn: 每次弹射的伤害衰减系数
洞穿心壁的凝视，让秘密无所遁形。
ref_en: A gaze that pierces the heart, leaving secrets with nowhere to hide.

source_cn: 激发光华在敌人之间折射，造成伤害、滞涩效果并获得神秘知识（用于解锁终结技能），可被技能知识逐人强化，造成的伤害提高并附加减速、减攻效果。
ref_en: Excite brilliance to refract between enemies, dealing damage and stagnation while gaining mysterious knowledge (used to unlock finisher skills). Can be strengthened by the Knowledge Pursuit skill, increasing damage and adding slow and attack reduction.

source_cn: 火车贸易：面板被强制关闭，非正常退出游戏
ref_en: Train Trade: Panel force-closed, abnormal game exit

source_cn: 猎杀管家每半小时随机现身一次。战况激烈时，还会有第二位猎杀管家同时登场！
ref_en: The Hunting Butler appears randomly every half hour. When the battle is intense, a second Hunting Butler will appear at the same time!

source_cn: 神奇生物保护协会成员 凯文
ref_en: Kevin, member of the Magical Creature Protection Association

source_cn: 肚子痛工人-东北社区口
茉莉拿铁……我的家乡也有很多茉莉。
ref_en: Jasmine latte... my hometown also has a lot of jasmine.

source_cn: 融合了蒙特利非凡特性的面具……需要占卜一下它的危险程度。
ref_en: The mask fused with Monterey's Beyonder characteristics... I need to divine its level of danger.
